a: Lagos is Nigeria's largest city and commercial center.
Kano is a major city in northern Nigeria.
Rivers State is in the Niger Delta; capital is Port Harcourt.
Yoruba people are concentrated largely in southwestern Nigeria.
Hausa is widely spoken in northern Nigeria and nearby regions.
Igbo people are concentrated largely in southeastern Nigeria.
ISO currency code for Naira is NGN.
The Super Eagles are Nigeria's men's national football team.
Nollywood is Nigeria's film industry, one of the world's largest by volume.
AFCON is the Africa Cup of Nations football tournament.
